subject: Mobile Development
title: Android Go: For Budget Phones
description: A micro-lesson that makes Android Go: For Budget Phones usable.

hook.text: A billion people use phones with 1-2 GB of RAM. Standard Android is too heavy for them.

buildup.text: Android Go is a lightweight version designed for entry-level devices with limited specs.

discovery.text: Go apps use less storage and data. YouTube Go streams video using 75% less data.

twist.text: Many budget phone makers ship Android Go without telling users. They think it's regular Android.

climax.text: Android Go brings smartphones to people who could never afford high-end hardware.

punchline.text: A lighter OS for the next billion users.

quiz.question: What is Android Go designed for?
options: Budget phones with limited RAM and storage
